children.name: Orchidantha yunnanensis P.Zou, C.F.Xiao & Škorničk.
children.description: Description: — Perennial, clump-forming herb, 50 – 150 cm tall. Rhizomes erect, ca. 1 cm in diameter, white internally. Petiole 19 – 57 cm, furrowed, sheathing in basal 1 / 3. Leaf blade narrowly elliptic, obviously unequal, 77 – 125 × 15 – 19.5 cm, green and glabrous on both sides, obtuse at base, acuminate at apex.
